guardrail: Neither administrative/design area is the affected compaction area; use the admitted polygon for spatial identity and derive geometry area from that polygon when needed.

guardrail: Admission is for peilgebied geometry only. It is not affected compaction area; GPGOPPVL=1506 is not admitted as exact geometry area and practice/status-1 or obsolete/status-11 variants are excluded.

claim_statement: Tollebeek OT.02 is a managed polder system and should not default to free drainage in SWAP source-response work.
guardrail: Exact event boundary/control behaviour still requires current operational evidence.

claim_statement: 540 m3/min is the admitted IJsvogel installed-capacity benchmark.
guardrail: Installed capacity is not event-specific available incremental capacity and not total OT.02 effective capacity.

claim_statement: Current effective Kievit operating capacity is unknown; 60 m3/min nominal hardware and 1.44 m3/s historical calculated capacity are retained as different quantities.
guardrail: Do not convert the two values into a simple min/max range; require post-2020 pump curve or telemetry.

claim_statement: Kievit-zone water may be assisted by IJsvogel under extreme conditions, so pump allocation must be represented explicitly rather than with one universal pumped fraction.
guardrail: No default assist fraction or reverse IJsvogel-core to Kievit routing is admitted.

claim_statement: Historical Noordoostpolder SWAP drainage parameters can be used as bounded method priors but not as current OT.02 calibration values.
guardrail: Current drainage geometry and resistance require spatial/current evidence.

claim_statement: Current OT.02 peilgebied geometry and the bounded eight-profile modal context basis are admitted; current anthropogenic compaction-state qualification remains data-gated.
guardrail: The profile basis is derived/modal context only. Screening fractions are not exact area weights, and modal bulk density is not CURRENT or REFERENCE soil state.

claim_statement: A compaction state cannot be converted to one universal crop or hydrological damage coefficient because limiting mechanisms and response magnitude depend on soil/profile properties, weather and boundary conditions.
guardrail: Pathway-specific response relations remain necessary; this claim does not provide a numeric response function.

claim_statement: The project reference state must be contextual and explicitly defined; a field-experiment control or apparently low-compaction soil is not automatically an uncompacted or damage-free counterfactual.
guardrail: Reference selection must remain traceable to the causal question and profile/land-use context.

claim_statement: Hydrological source-response modelling should preserve compacted-layer depth/thickness and the thickness of overlying storage rather than reduce the profile to one compaction scalar.
guardrail: Exact layer resolution and hydraulic functions remain model/configuration decisions requiring qualification.

claim_statement: Runoff qualification for compacted profiles requires sub-daily event forcing; hourly precipitation is a defensible baseline for the documented SWAP studies but not a universal temporal sufficiency rule.
guardrail: Shorter-duration intensity may still matter and water-system routing has its own time resolution.

claim_statement: Plot/profile evidence cannot by itself determine catchment, pump or societal impacts; an explicit transfer and aggregation layer is required between source response and off-site consequences.
guardrail: No generic plot-to-catchment scaling factor is implied.

claim_statement: Soil × land-use classes are a defensible national exposure/aggregation architecture, but process response and valuation remain pathway-specific and must not be encoded as universal coefficients in the class definition.
guardrail: The Graves UK classes and probabilities are precedent only; Dutch classes and response evidence must be constructed independently.

claim_statement: The project must keep private/on-site effects, public-budget expenditure and broader societal/external welfare effects conceptually separate until an explicit valuation relation connects a qualified physical effect to a cost category.
guardrail: Historical cost estimates or accounting expenditures are not automatically current societal welfare losses.

claim_statement: Historical or large-scale numerical studies may be used for context, sensitivity or external comparison but must not become current Dutch model parameters without matching scope and qualification.
guardrail: Preserve source population, crop, climate, time period and modelling assumptions when using benchmarks.

claim_statement: The architecture should be capable of representing multiple soil-service consequences from the same soil-state definition while keeping each response and valuation pathway separately qualified.
guardrail: A common soil state does not imply that crop, nitrogen, carbon and runoff responses share one transfer or uncertainty model.

claim_statement: Eight SoilPhys modal source-profile definitions detected across two shifted 500 m grids form the admitted bounded OT.02 profile-context basis, with full depth-resolved layer context retained through 120 cm.
guardrail: Retain all eight profiles; do not treat sampling fractions as exact areal weights and do not interpret modal SoilPhys bulk density as current anthropogenic compaction.

claim_statement: No Tollebeek CURRENT soil-state value is admitted until source-native georeferenced measurements or a separately qualified derivation can be assigned reproducibly to the admitted OT.02 domain with date, depth, method and QC provenance. The 2020-2021 Flevoland field campaign is a qualified acquisition route for dated measured states, not an OT.02-wide or automatic 2026 CURRENT state.
guardrail: Do not substitute SoilPhys modal density, province-wide percentages, an unreliable regional interpolation or visually inferred map points for source georeferenced current-state records.

claim_statement: Owner data establish widespread parcel-drainage inventory coverage and a much newer open-water/water-system topology for OT.02, but no current source-model drainage configuration is admitted until selected-unit drain spacing/density, drain depth/elevation and the mapping to model drainage parameters are supported by qualified evidence.
guardrail: Do not interpret zero/null owner fields as physical values, copy historical 100 d/30 d resistances, or substitute open-water topology for subsurface drain geometry.

claim_statement: The KNMI station-273 Marknesse hourly series from 24-30 October 1998 is admitted as the bounded observed meteorological forcing baseline for the first Tollebeek extreme-event experiment, with event core 27 October 06:00 UTC to 28 October 06:00 UTC (88.4 mm in 24 hours).
guardrail: Admission is station-based forcing only. It does not admit an exact OT.02 rainfall field, hydrological initial state, managed-boundary behaviour, crop state, drainage parameters or any SWAP-specific variable mapping.

claim_statement: Public historical groundwater evidence now provides a qualified acquisition route and deep/nearby event-context anchors for October 1998, but no event-specific shallow groundwater table or depth-resolved soil-water initial state is admitted for OT.02. The first source-model pair must therefore remain blocked on initial state until a local observation is recovered or a separately qualified reproducible warm-up/restart protocol becomes possible.
guardrail: Do not convert the owner narrative fully saturated into a numeric profile; do not equate deep piezometric head or OT.02 target peil with phreatic groundwater level; do not interpolate outside shallow candidates into OT.02; do not introduce field-capacity or hydrostatic convenience defaults.

claim_statement: The October 1998 managed boundary must be represented using the historical pre-IJsvogel Tollebeek control system, not the present merged OT.02/IJsvogel system. Official near-period evidence constrains historical target levels, topology and nominal capacities, and owner event accounts establish emergency intervention, but no event-specific surface-water-level, pump-discharge or control time series is currently admitted. The managed boundary therefore remains data-gated and must be identical or explicitly equivalent across matched CURRENT and REFERENCE runs once qualified.
spatial_scope: Historical Tollebeek OT02/OT03/OT04 control system / October 1998 event
guardrail: Do not use current IJsvogel/current merged OT.02 controls as a 1998 substitute; do not treat NAP -6.20 target as the actual event water-level series; do not convert nameplate capacity to realized discharge; do not choose a SWAP lower-boundary option in this evidence-route workunit.

claim_statement: Broad historical land use around Tollebeek is constrained as predominantly arable agriculture with some forest, and LGN3/LGN4 provide qualified pre/post-event spatial context. However no source currently admits parcel/profile-level crop identity or vegetation state for the October 1998 experiment. Because LGN3 in Flevoland reflects 1995 and LGN4 reflects 1999/2000 and crop changes can reflect rotation, a 1998 crop must not be interpolated or defaulted. DR_SM_LAND_USE therefore remains data-gated until event-relevant crop/vegetation evidence or an explicitly scenario-based model design is separately qualified.
spatial_scope: Tollebeek historical control areas / October 1998 source-model experiment
guardrail: Do not use LGN3 1995, LGN4 1999/2000, a representative arable crop, or a late-October bare-soil assumption as an observed 1998 crop state. A scenario is not an observation and must be labelled/qualified separately.

claim_statement: The SWAP source-model family is project-intended and the SWAP5 authority chain is now qualified for configuration design: scientific executable authority 50346642bd565f79134ea17d5462e544b354998c, Status-A acceptance authority 992a5c657bfe10a10100f92e0cb77c4825ae65b6, with live canonical governance tracked separately. This is not yet a Tollebeek model configuration because several controlled scientific inputs remain unresolved. DR_SM_MODEL_CONFIG therefore remains data/configuration-gated until a concrete versioned configuration explicitly binds all required controlled dimensions without convenience defaults.
spatial_scope: First paired Tollebeek source-model experiment / EVT_TOL_1998_OCT
guardrail: Do not treat executable-authority pinning as admission of a runnable configuration. No missing drainage, initial-state, managed-boundary, crop/vegetation or CURRENT/REFERENCE soil-state value may be replaced by a SWAP default or convenience assumption.

claim_statement: A measured or constructed soil state must be linked through an explicit versioned hydraulic parameterization before SWAP source-response execution; bulk density or penetration resistance alone does not identify the full hydraulic function.
guardrail: No numerical Tollebeek hydraulic values, PTF coefficients or compacted/uncompacted multipliers are admitted by this architecture claim.

claim_statement: For sandy grassland, the recovered Dutch evidence does not support one monotonic compaction-to-yield coefficient: moderate compaction can outperform both very loose and heavier treatments, and drought-sensitive sites can show sign changes through altered moisture supply.
guardrail: Use a scenario/context ensemble; do not create a universal negative grass-yield coefficient.

claim_statement: Dutch sandy-soil maize evidence shows potentially material yield effects of traffic-induced compaction, but response magnitude depends strongly on axle load, profile and weather and is not calibrated to current CC-NL severity classes. Soil-improvement model scenarios provide separate inverse/context evidence.
guardrail: Retain field-treatment and soil-improvement evidence as distinct ensemble members; no current national coefficient is admitted.

claim_statement: The published 2018 CC-NL framework may be used as a structural reporting/area baseline, but no current national on-site damage calculation may treat it as 2026 compaction exposure. Current affected fractions must remain blank until depth- and severity-resolved exposure is obtained or a separately qualified scenario is defined.
guardrail: Do not fill current exposure from headline prevalence figures, historical zero-measurement area shares, or synthetic demo values.

claim_statement: Silage-maize area within sandy soil strata should be derived by reproducible spatial intersection of a versioned BRP crop-parcel layer with a compatible soil-class layer. National CBS maize area is a closure/context check, not a rule for distributing maize across soils.
guardrail: Do not set maize_share from the ratio of national maize area to total arable area or assume all sandy arable land is maize.

claim_statement: Crop-specific on-site valuation should bind an explicit economic perspective to versioned source values. KWIN-AGV and BINternet are qualified input routes, but no economic coefficient is admitted until exact variables, price year and accounting/welfare interpretation are selected.
guardrail: Gross revenue, farmer-private marginal damage, production value and societal welfare are different measures and must not be silently substituted or added.

claim_statement: A current silage-maize × soil reporting crosswalk may be constructed by intersecting definitive BRP crop geometry with a versioned BRO SGM soil model, but every intersecting BRO soil_unit_code must be mapped explicitly and reviewably to one CC-NL6 class before an area result is admitted.
guardrail: No unknown soil code may default to ZO or another residual class; geometry closure and source hashes are mandatory.

claim_statement: A BRP × current BRO SGM overlay is a current spatial classification approximation for the CC-NL6 reporting categories, not a reconstruction of the 2018 LSK-based domain membership or its historical area estimator.
guardrail: Report current-map crosswalk outputs separately from the published 2018 CC-NL domain areas and do not force agreement by proportional scaling.

claim_statement: Official BRO family semantics may be used to generate deterministic candidate CC-NL6 mappings, but no proposal becomes a qualified soil_unit_code mapping automatically. Ambiguous families remain review-required and every mapping used by the overlay must still be explicitly QUALIFIED.
guardrail: AUTO_PROPOSAL is workflow assistance, not scientific admission; no fallback class is allowed.

claim_statement: The maize×soil input sources should be materialized by preserving source-native BRP API pages and the original BRO SGM download before transformation, with SHA-256 and source-request/version metadata retained. Acquisition remains distinct from scientific admission.
guardrail: Do not treat successful downloading, filtering or hashing as admission of crop×soil shares, soil-code mappings, compaction exposure or damage.
